hypothesis: Keeping direct query scaling while replacing remainder counts with complete attention-pair counts may explain additional matrix-multiplication work, particularly at length 48. This differs from iteration 1 by exposing query size independently of context size.

pcvs.name: query_elements
pcvs.rationale: Retains direct query-row scaling, which improved the previous result.

pcvs.expression: hidden_states.shape[0] * attn.heads * hidden_states.shape[1] * (hidden_states.shape[1] if encoder_hidden_states is None else encoder_hidden_states.shape[1])
pcvs.name: attention_pairs
pcvs.rationale: Captures the complete attention matrix, including work on full context blocks omitted by the remainder-only feature.

pcvs.expression: hidden_states.shape[0] * hidden_states.shape[1] * attn.inner_dim if rotary_emb is not None else 0
pcvs.name: rotary_elements
pcvs.rationale: Captures token-dependent rotary work separately from shared query processing.
